welcome.title: Discover who's out near you
welcome.desc: See lively places around you in real time and the people there — right now.

checkin.title: Automatic check-in, day or night
checkin.desc: As soon as you enter a place, you show up there automatically — and you see who's there. The app switches between Day mode (cafés, parks, sports…) and Night mode (bars, restaurants, clubs…) as you like.

profile.title: Your profile, the places that move
profile.desc: Add your social networks so people can find you, check out profiles around you. Each place also shows 1 to 3 stars based on real attendance — the busier it is, the brighter it shines.

referral.title: A friend invited you?
referral.desc: Enter their referral code (optional) — it helps them unlock a free month of Premium.

locationPrimer.title: Turn on your location
locationPrimer.desc: LoocateMe uses your location to show you lively places and people around you. Without it, the app can't work.
locationPrimer.note: On the next screen, choose "Allow While Using App".
locationPrimer.alwaysTitle: Stay visible without opening the app
locationPrimer.alwaysDesc: With automatic mode, your check-ins and check-outs happen on their own — your friends see you arrive even when your phone is in your pocket. For that, LoocateMe needs background access to your location ("Always" permission).
locationPrimer.alwaysIosHint: iOS may ask in two steps: first allow "While Using the App", then "Always" when the app prompts you.

views.title: Who's visiting you?

superlikes.desc: Show special interest in someone you notice.

invisible.title: Invisible mode
invisible.desc: Disappear from the list of nearby users whenever you want.

radius.title: Extended radius
radius.desc: Explore up to 30 km around you (2 km on the free plan).

stats.title: Advanced stats
stats.desc: Track views and clicks across all your social networks.
